end.summary: Defined melting ice as a reversible physical change with no new substance.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised physical and chemical changes using melting ice, dissolving sugar, cooking chapati, curd formation, and burning a wick. They used reversibility, colour, smell, and whether a new substance forms as clues. Ananya first said dissolved sugar had no mass, then stated that the total was 220 g; this idea should be revisited because the record shows it was not yet secure. At home, dissolve sugar in water and discuss how evaporation can recover the sugar.
